notes: B3 complete. Three-column board layout (360px left / flex middle / 320px right; min-width 1280px, no h-scroll). New order form with exact field order Phone→Name→Pickup→Dropoff→When→Passengers→Note, one tab-stop each (quick chips have tabIndex=-1). F2 window-level keydown focuses Phone from anywhere. Enter key (onKeyDown with e.preventDefault() to stop native double-submit) submits from any non-textarea field. Quick chips (4 hardcoded: Kolín station, KH station, hospital, bus station) fill pickup with coords directly — no geo call. AddressInput Enter-select has e.stopPropagation() so selecting an autocomplete suggestion does NOT trigger form submission. Debounced autocomplete via useAddressSuggest → GET /geo/suggest. Live price preview via useRouteEstimate → GET /geo/route (F-03: renders estimatedPriceCzk directly; absent on 502 or null tariff). Form clears and refocuses Phone on successful submit. useNewOrderHighlightStore (zustand) stores {orderId, createdAt} after submit for B4 to render 3s highlight. Phone normalization mirrors backend PhoneNormalizer exactly (bare 9-digit → +420 prefix, E.164 passthrough, spaces/dashes stripped). PriceType matches backend enum: 'Estimate' when estimatedPriceCzk present, 'Meter' when null (was incorrectly 'Metered' — fixed against PriceType.cs). scheduledAt sent as ISO-8601 UTC string via new Date(v).toISOString() to avoid browser TZ ambiguity. Map toggle placeholder button (disabled) added to middle column header using board.mapToggle i18n key. Locales parity green (cs/en have identical board.* key sets). Deviations: (D1) Enter submit uses onKeyDown + e.preventDefault() (not native form submit) to ensure the AddressInput's suggestion selection Enter (which calls e.stopPropagation) prevents form submission, while normal field Enter submits exactly once. (D2) useRouteEstimate uses plain useState/useEffect with debounce timer, not TanStack Query's useQuery — avoids queryKey change complexity with debounced coords.
